title: Containerise + adapt 6 callers (STAR-Fusion, Arriba, FusionCatcher, JAFFA, deFuse, pizzly)
context: M2 multi-caller integration for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Containerises the six named fusion callers (STAR-Fusion, Arriba, FusionCatcher, JAFFA, deFuse, pizzly) behind one uniform run(...) -> normalized_calls adapter so every caller is benchmarked identically on the same pinned GRCh38 reference. Pinning by container digest is the reproducibility guarantee; no patient data is used.
objective: Containerise and adapt the six named callers behind the uniform adapter so each emits the canonical FusionCall on the single pinned GRCh38 reference, with a CI smoke test per caller.
acceptanceCriteria: >=6 callers pinned by container digest behind the uniform run(...)->normalized_calls adapter; each emits the canonical FusionCall.
All use the single pinned GRCh38 reference + annotation (no GRCh37).
Smoke test passes for each caller in CI.
output: A pull request adding callers/ adapters + pinned container definitions for the six callers behind the uniform adapter.
